Use structured AWS service error codes for RPC `error.type` in preview conventions, retaining the existing exception-class fallback when codes are missing.

- **SDK v1:** Read `AmazonServiceException.getErrorCode()`.
- **SDK v2:** Read `AwsServiceException.awsErrorDetails().errorCode()`.
- Preserve legacy HTTP classification and existing error handling.
metadata.title: Classify AWS SDK service error codes
